items.title: Tom Scott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and I’m extremely pleased to have Tom Scott with me here... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh it’s my pleasure, Monk.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m extremely pleased to have Tom Scott with me here. It’s morning in your time zone and I’m in the afternoon. And thank you so much for joining me.
The first question I have is rather an easy one: I’ve been reading through the list of your accomplishments in all the fields and I’m wondering is there possibly more than one Tom Scott?
